name: services-system-boot-themes
description: GRUB and Plymouth branding. Alternatives — a host boots with one splash, and its GRUB menu matches it. Each member is the Plymouth/GRUB pair, because a Kartoza menu handing over to a QGIS splash reads as a fault.

choiceDetails.kartoza: Kartoza branding: the house Plymouth splash and the GRUB menu that matches it. The fleet default.
choiceDetails.qgis: QGIS 'Spatial without Compromise': navy cartographic artwork with a QGIS-green accent, shared by the splash and the GRUB menu so the hand-off is continuous. Used by the QGIS workstations.
